sermon.title: The Battle - February 25, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: Following the real deal, this message traces Israel’s deliverance from Egypt. God saw His people, came down to deliver them and promised wonders, but Pharaoh, a picture of Satan, would not let go. The elders and even Moses forgot the signs. Stay connected to Jesus, put on the armor, and don’t quit like Lot’s wife, Demas or Jonah. Wait patiently with joy until God works.

faqs.question: How are guests welcomed?
faqs.answer: God bless them; they’ll get a big hug at the end.

faqs.question: Who would you bet on?
faqs.answer: Jesus; He is much more powerful and stronger.

faqs.question: What if something didn’t change when I got saved?
faqs.answer: Like an addiction, keep fighting until God works His wonders.

faqs.question: Should we worry if Satan is unhappy?
faqs.answer: No; if Satan doesn’t like it, that’s his problem.

faqs.question: Whose job is it to save people?
faqs.answer: Not ours; our job is to lead people to the Savior.

faqs.question: Must we wait for national revival?
faqs.answer: You don’t have to wait for God’s calendar to become part of the glorious church.

faqs.question: Can anyone know God?
faqs.answer: Yes; rich or raised in poverty with a horrible past, if you humble yourself.

faqs.question: What is the belt of truth like?
faqs.answer: You’ve got to keep your pants up.

faqs.question: What does he think of Jonah?
faqs.answer: He doesn’t understand him; it’s wonderful when people repent.

faqs.question: Do we want God to just do it?
faqs.answer: We want it in five seconds while we sit in our chair watching our show.
